t.why: The EU's third-largest economy; sitting in the middle of the Mediterranean, migration from North Africa is a major foreign-policy issue.
t.rel: The Alps give it borders with France, Switzerland, Austria and Slovenia, and the Vatican and San Marino lie inside it. Across the Mediterranean it works with Libya and Tunisia to stop migrant boats. It is a founding member of the EU and a NATO member.
t.korea: It sent a medical unit during the Korean War. Trade with Korea in fashion, design and machinery is brisk.
t.know: Two entire countries, Vatican City and San Marino, lie inside Italy.
t.etext: Strong in manufacturing such as machinery, fashion, luxury goods, food and cars, centered in the north. It is also a tourism giant. Government debt is very high, and the income gap between south and north is wide.
